categories.description: Bridged and cage-like polycycles.

categories.description: Common crown ethers and selected derivatives.

categories.title: Heterocycles

categories.title: Polycyclics
categories.description: Fused and cage polycycles.

categories.title: Beta D sugars
categories.description: Named beta-D sugars with ring form and anomer recorded.

categories.title: Deoxynucleosides
categories.description: Named 2'-deoxyribonucleosides.

categories.description: Free nucleobases, not nucleosides.

categories.description: Named ribonucleosides.

categories.title: Organometallics

categories.title: Peptide building blocks
categories.description: Complete protected amino acids. No sequence builder.

categories.title: Protoalkaloids
categories.description: Amino-acid-derived amines whose nitrogen is not in a heterocycle.

categories.description: Amino-acid-derived alkaloids with nitrogen in a heterocycle.

categories.title: Pseudoalkaloids
categories.description: Nitrogenous metabolites whose skeleton is not from an amino acid.

categories.title: Vitamins
categories.description: Named vitamers, not family names.

categories.title: My Templates
categories.description: Existing user store. Not a shipped category.

categories.title: Solvents and reagents
categories.description: Common laboratory solvents and simple reagents.

categories.description: Small complete molecules illustrating common functional groups.

categories.description: A few recognizable terpenes and steroids.
